Chroma Quote Workbench

Select a module to begin or continue your insurance quote.

Crimson: Quote Initiation

Start a new insurance quote by capturing the client and policy basics, then confirm coverage limits and add-ons.

Start Crimson Journey →

Amber: Applicant & Asset

Capture applicant personal details and details of the vehicle or property being insured.

Start Amber Journey →

Verdant: Risk & Discounts

Run a risk questionnaire covering claims history and offer available discounts before premium calculation.

Start Verdant Journey →

Azure: Premium & Review

Summarise the calculated premium and payment cadence, and review the complete quote details.

Start Azure Journey →

Violet: Payment & Confirm

Collect payment details to finalise the purchase, then confirm the transaction and provide confirmation.

Start Violet Journey →
